messages:
eli: Quick RFC follow-up  need a final, tiny telemetry contract + who owns precision switching for FP8/INT8/4-bit. Keep it minimal so we can ship instrumentation tomorrow.

sun: For 100% traffic: precision_profile_id (GUID), precision_profile_label, model@version, degradation_score (scalar), mean_token_confidence, batching_latency_ms, gpu_mem_pct, prompt_fp (sha256). low-cardinality only.

marta: Add kv_cache_hits and a cheap mismatch proxy: top1_mismatch_rate vs shadowed golden. Per-layer arrays are sampled only (configurable sample_rate). Always emit sample_rate when present.

sophia: Ownership: control plane manages rollouts and preferred_profile. runtime has emergency overrides only when CP unreachable. Runtime MAY fallback if (infra_pressure AND quality_safe) with 2-window hysteresis to avoid flapping.

eli: What is infra_pressure and quality_safe concretely? need simple numbers for runbook.

sophia: infra_pressure = (gpu_mem_pct > 92 OR p95_latency > 2xSLO). quality_safe = (degradation_score < 0.02). Runtime requires both and two consecutive windows before applying fallback_profile (declared on profiles).

mike: Canary knobs: start 0.5% traffic. Shadow-sample per-layer for all canary requests. Auto-rollback if median degradation_score > 0.045 for 5m OR top_k_mismatch_rate spikes > 0.03. Promotion above 5% needs human sign-off.

marta: Also capture tokens_saved_pct and cost_delta_usd in telemetry so product can judge tradeoffs. Gate should be multi-dimensional (quality vs cost).

sun: Draft minimal flat schema (scalars only) to append to the RFC:
```
request_id: uuid
model: redwood-base@v2
precision_profile_id: guid-xxxxx
precision_profile_label: fp8_headwise_fast
variant: latency
degradation_score: 0.028
mean_token_confidence: 0.86
mean_abs_delta: 0.0017
top_k_mismatch_rate: 0.006
kv_cache_hits: 8
batching_latency_ms: 11
gpu_mem_pct: 74
tokens_saved_pct: 12.5
cost_delta_usd: -0.0023
prompt_fp: sha256:abcd...
prompt_redacted: true
sample_rate: 0.01
```

eli: Good. Ops wants immutable profile ids and explicit fallback_profile_id on each profile to avoid ad-hoc fallbacks. Also runtime must log reason_code and metric_snapshot whenever it overrides.

sophia: FSM sketch for runbook (pseudocode) included:
```
state = NORMAL
if control_plane_unreachable && (gpu_mem_pct>92 || p95>2*SLO) && degradation_score<0.02 then
  if consecutive_windows>=2 -> state=EMERGENCY_FALLBACK; apply fallback_profile_id; emit audit_log
if state==EMERGENCY_FALLBACK and (control_plane_reachable || degradation_score>=0.02) then
  if control_plane_reachable -> revert per control plane
  else if degradation_score>=0.02 -> escalate human_oncall
```

mike: Also add telemetry retention defaults: 30d, enterprise optics 90d with review. Always hash prompt fingerprints and never emit raw prompt by default.

sophia: Can we include a small composite gate example in the RFC appendix? e.g., gate_score = 0.7*degradation_score_norm + 0.3*max(0, -cost_delta_norm) so teams can tune weights.

marta: Eval asked for 4 golden prompt families to compute degradation_score; @eval-team please drop examples. We need them to set thresholds.

quant-bot: "RFC follow-up captured: minimal telemetry schema + sampled per-layer, control-plane primary + runtime emergency override FSM, canary thresholds, retention and PII rules. Action items: @sun publish schema appendix, @sophia PR FSM, @mike draft canary playbook, @marta coordinate eval examples." :white_check_mark:

eli: Thanks all  I'll update the RFC appendix and we can start instrumenting tomorrow.
